parameters.query:
WITH revised AS (
  UPDATE cuisine_social.posts
  SET source_snapshot = source_snapshot || jsonb_build_object(
        '_social_approval_revision', $8::text,
        '_social_approval_history', jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
          'revision', 'initial',
          'status', status,
          'human_decision', human_decision,
          'human_note', human_note,
          'decided_at', decided_at,
          'approved_at', approved_at,
          'facebook_caption', facebook_caption,
          'instagram_caption', instagram_caption,
          'image_url', image_url
        ))
      ),
      facebook_caption = $5,
      instagram_caption = $6,
      status = 'draft',
      human_decision = NULL,
      human_note = NULL,
      decided_at = NULL,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE $8::text = 'kampong-speu-v6-2'
    AND id = 5 AND scheduled_date = DATE '2026-11-25' AND scheduled_date = $4::date
    AND source_id = $1 AND source_id = 'culture:sucre-de-palme-kampong-speu'
    AND source_fingerprint = $2 AND source_fingerprint = '58677de429e00662'
    AND source_snapshot = $3::jsonb
    AND NOT (source_snapshot ?| ARRAY['_social_approval_revision','_social_approval_history'])
    AND image_url = $7
    AND status = 'revision_requested' AND human_decision = 'revision_requested'
    AND NULLIF(btrim(human_note), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND decided_at = TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-11-24 21:19:02.967073+00' AND updated_at = decided_at
    AND approved_at IS NULL AND publishing_started_at IS NULL AND published_at IS NULL
    AND fb_state = 'pending' AND ig_state = 'pending'
    AND facebook_post_id IS NULL AND instagram_container_id IS NULL AND instagram_post_id IS NULL
    AND encode(sha256(convert_to(facebook_caption,'UTF8')),'hex') = 'a9a7ac3c772c22ea44964922e3f97ce5c19827bf59a57f196bc8aa47b64e774b'
    AND encode(sha256(convert_to(instagram_caption,'UTF8')),'hex') = 'ffb37d4f160b5534c2dd60e36d73e3c5097ed04ac9f9a5944d108a861245fb2c'
  RETURNING id,scheduled_date,source_snapshot->>'_social_approval_revision' AS approval_revision
), inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO cuisine_social.posts(source_id,source_fingerprint,source_snapshot,scheduled_date,facebook_caption,instagram_caption,image_url)
  SELECT $1,$2,$3::jsonb,$4::date,$5,$6,$7
  WHERE $8::text = 'initial'
  ON CONFLICT (scheduled_date) DO NOTHING RETURNING id,scheduled_date,'initial'::text AS approval_revision
)
SELECT id,scheduled_date,approval_revision FROM revised
UNION ALL
SELECT id,scheduled_date,approval_revision FROM inserted

parameters.query: UPDATE cuisine_social.posts SET status=$1, human_decision=$1, human_note=$2, decided_at=NOW(), approved_at=CASE WHEN $1='approved' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$3 AND status='draft' AND approved_at IS NULL AND human_decision IS NULL AND COALESCE(source_snapshot->>'_social_approval_revision','initial')=$4 RETURNING id,status,human_note
